headline: 90% of Danantara's Rp259.6 T Profit Contributed by These 6 BUMN
summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund BPI Danantara recorded net profit of Rp259.6 trillion in 2025. Six state-owned enterprises contributed 90% of the total.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, managing stakes in state-owned enterprises and investment capital.
original_headline: 90% Laba Danantara Rp259,6 T Disumbang Oleh 6 BUMN Ini
